FN-PS44CRR-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 17
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Bill Lamb
Government
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/09/2026
House Bill 17 as introduced would revise the current annual audit requirements for
municipalities to provide that certain municipalities may submit biennial audits or an annual
financial report, in lieu of an annual audit. These provisions could decrease the obligations of
those municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in: (1) the cost to
perform the biennial audit or financial report pursuant to this bill, and (2) the cost to otherwise
conduct an annual audit as currently provided by law.
